records.title: CEA whole-slide IHC image
records.description: Research copy of the CEA-stained whole slide with all four tissue pyramid levels and native compressed image tiles preserved. Original label, macro and thumbnail images are omitted.
records.specimen_description: Liver left lateral segment from the October 2024 resection; matching PPMG report case and slide label confirmed.
records.source_lossy_encoding: Original JPEG-compressed tissue tiles copied without recompression.

Metadata, complete generic ICC profile, source overview and margins were reviewed. No claim of full-resolution visual review of every pixel.
